rules.statement: Chena lands, as defined by the Ordinance of 1897, are presumed to be the property of the Crown unless proven otherwise.
rules.supporting_quote: "All forest, waste, unoccupied, or uncultivated lands, and all Chena and other lands which can be only cultivated after intervals of several years, shall be presumed to be the property of the Crown until the contrary thereof be proved."

meta.parties: Hamid Et Al v. The Special Officer Appointed Under the Waste Lands Ordinance
